name: accordion-unfold
title: Accordion Unfold
description: A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it. The placeholder lockup is a stand-in: a host prints its own logo by replacing the .au-print contents in the script.
useWhen: A print, stationery, travel or editorial brand wants a tactile reveal, like opening a folded brochure or map.
Your logo should sit on a card or label rather than float on the background.
avoidWhen: The logo should float freely on the background instead of on a card: use spotlight or anamorphic-flare.
The paper motion is a scene change, not a logo reveal: use page-turn.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Wordmark
variables.description: Placeholder lockup text printed across the card.

variables.label: Shade
variables.description: Darkness of the panels facing away from the light, 0 to 1.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Stage color, also the lockup color printed on the paper.

variables.label: Fold angle
variables.description: Fold angle of each pleat at the start, in degrees.
